expected_behavior: A markdown API design draft is converted into a valid OpenAPI YAML document, not paraphrased: endpoints, schemas and auth definitions from the draft become the spec's paths, components and securitySchemes.
The generated YAML is validated as well-formed before it is written, and the output lands at the location the skill names rather than wherever the agent happens to be.
Unresolved design decisions are listed under Open Questions instead of being guessed, and are resolved before implementation.
